focus: Angle 12 — leaf-manifest generation and doctrine reachability

findingDetails.title: Leaf-manifest walker skips symlinks and both freshness gates regenerate with the same walker, leaving twelve sk-code doctrine leaves invisible behind green gates
findingDetails.evidence: walkLeafFiles accepts only entry.isFile() (:83-84), so the twelve doctrine symlinks under the four sk-code surface packets never project; collectModeEntries walks references/assets only (:179-180). Observed: generate-leaf-manifest.cjs --check .opencode/skills/sk-code exits 0 with digest 0356321a... while all twelve files are absent from the manifest; both fleet gates regenerate through buildManifestBytes and byte-compare (ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs:191-229, ci-leaf-manifest-freshness.cjs:1-30).
findingDetails.impact: A one-line walker defect makes twelve declared loadable files invisible to every typed consumer, and the gate that exists to catch manifest drift structurally cannot see it.
findingDetails.recommendation: Follow symlinks in walkLeafFiles (resolve and include when the target is a file), regenerate all manifests, then prove the twelve leaves appear and the gates still pass. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Computed disk-minus-manifest as a set difference for all three hubs and eighteen modes (exactly 12 misses, all symlinks, all sk-code surfaces), executed the check command and read exit status plus digest, and read both gates to confirm they share the generator's builder.

findingDetails.title: Three shared workflow doctrine files project as no typed resource and are reachable only through prose sentences
findingDetails.evidence: The shared sources under shared/references/ are in no mode packet; the twelve surface symlinks are invisible to the walker; ROUTER.md's eight SHARED_CONTROL_RESOURCES (:626-637) contain no workflow path. What remains is prose: SKILL.md:39 and :192, shared/README.md:43-45, surface SKILL.md sites (webflow:16, opencode:16, obsidian:62, mobile-cli:61) and hand-off sentences in sk-code-quality:37-38,48-49,187-188 and sk-code-review:44-45.
findingDetails.impact: A leaf-driven or compiled consumer selecting the surface's bundled doctrine cannot resolve it, and the SKILL.md load-path sentence has no typed backing from any artifact.
findingDetails.recommendation: Either fix F024's walker so the surfaces carry typed doctrine leaves, or move the doctrine into the declared shared-control set and align SKILL.md:39 with that mechanism. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Searched every hub RESOURCE_MAP and both shared-control lists for a workflow-* path, enumerated every citation of the three filenames across the six sk-code packets, and confirmed the shared sources are regular files whose surface copies are the symlinks F024 drops.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: A generator, two fleet gates, eighteen mode manifests and a twelve-file symlink set across three hubs, with the defect population computed by set difference and the gate blindness proved by executing the check command.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Angle 12 names the generator, the files it cannot see and the sentences that are the only path to a file; the generator and both fleet gates are the production truth, and the shared/ tree is where the reachability question resolves.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The walker projects every file a surface packet carries under references/assets.

searchActions.queryOrPath: disk-minus-manifest for 3 hubs and 18 modes against the walker source
searchActions.result: Exactly 12 misses, all symlinks, all in the four sk-code surface packets; the walker's :83-84 accepts only entry.isFile().

searchLedger.rationale: The defect population is exact, not sampled, and the same walker backs both gates.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A fleet gate would report the twelve missing leaves as stale.

searchActions.result: Exit 0, leaf-manifest.json OK (0356321a...), proving byte-freshness cannot see the omission.

searchLedger.rationale: The gate regenerates with the same walker; the blindness is structural, not a stale-check miss.

searchLedger.invariant: A file a SKILL.md says a surface loads must be reachable through a typed artifact or declared control.

searchActions.queryOrPath: every citation of workflow-{implement,debug,verify}.md across the six sk-code packets plus the shared control list
searchActions.result: Only prose and link-table citations; no leaf, no RESOURCE_MAP entry, and the eight SHARED_CONTROL_RESOURCES exclude the doctrine.

searchLedger.rationale: The only path to the file is a sentence, which the typed layer cannot follow.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Other hubs carry invisible files of the same kind.

searchActions.queryOrPath: disk-minus-manifest for the five and seven modes of the other two hubs
searchActions.result: Zero misses in either hub; the defect is confined to sk-code's four surfaces.

searchLedger.rationale: Bounds the blast radius honestly and stops a fleet-wide fix claim.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Empty difference on both sibling hubs.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The alias mechanism is the intended carrier for the shared doctrine.

searchActions.queryOrPath: leaf-aliases.json presence on all three hubs
searchActions.result: No hub ships an alias file; the mechanism exists for relocated compatibility triples.

searchLedger.rationale: Closes the alternative carrier so F025's recommendation is the real choice.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No alias file exists on any hub.
